title: Every App says what state it is in and what to do next
description: An App's card, page header and Settings now read one state with one next action, including Needs an auth config, Available for an App off for the team, and Not installed for a plugin the system does not hold. In the API and SDK, appState gains needs_auth_config and not_installed, and an App installed but off for the team now reads off instead of not_installed.
